questions.stem_text:
Economic aid has largely failed to promote modernization in the developing countries
because:

options.A: there are no clearly defined projects into which the money can be directed
options.B: the United Nations has refused to call on rich countries to provide it
options.C: debt repayments with interest can be greater than the amount of money received
options.D: debt repayments with interest can be greater than the amount of money received

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - debt repayments with interest can be greater than the amount of money received

questions.stem_text:
The deviant subculture of homosexuals who met in seventeenth and eighteenth century London
was called the:
The alternative form of 'network organization' means that:

options.A: work can be subcontracted out to independent suppliers and retailers
options.B: business transactions occur only through electronic communication
options.C: the Japanese model is applied, through lateral networks of flexible roles
options.D: activities are redistributed equally between men and women

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - work can be subcontracted out to independent suppliers and retailers

questions.stem_text: In Durkheim's work, the term 'collective representations' refers to:

options.A: effervescent ceremonies that create a feeling of belonging
options.B: images of gods or totems that are widely recognized
options.C: shared ideas and moral values, often symbolized by an object or figurehead
options.D: ideological tools used to obscure class divisions

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - shared ideas and moral values, often symbolized by an object or figurehead

questions.stem_text: In the 1990 reform of the National Health Service, hospitals became:

options.A: self-governing trusts competing for purchasing contracts from health authorities
options.B: state-controlled providers, dependent on funding from the central government
options.C: increasingly detached from health authorities and providers of private health care
options.D: less inclined to run themselves efficiently, as demand for health care was falling

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - self-governing trusts competing for purchasing contracts from health authorities
